blocks.text: Shopee, the largest e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia and Taiwan and a leading e-commerce platform in Brazil, has launched ShopeeFood, its food delivery service, in the Philippines. The service is now available in Metro Manila, making the Philippines the fifth Southeast Asian market where Shopee offers food delivery as part of its broader marketplace offering. The launch builds on Shopee’s existing services, giving Filipino consumers another way to discover participating restaurants, place orders, pay and track deliveries through a platform they already use. “The launch of ShopeeFood in the Philippines builds on our commitment to bringing Filipino buyers more choice, value […]...
